title: 12 Best Coffee Shops in Shanghai
summary: The best specialty coffee shops in Shanghai — curated from Reddit. From Manner's ¥15 lattes to O.P.S. coffee cocktails, explore the city with 9,000+ cafes.

venues.name: Seesaw Coffee
venues.verdict: Shanghai's original specialty chain — the one that proved China could do world-class third wave coffee.

venues.name: Manner Coffee
venues.verdict: The chain that disrupted Shanghai's coffee market — genuinely great specialty coffee at Luckin prices.

venues.name: O.P.S. Cafe
venues.verdict: The pioneer of Shanghai's coffee cocktail scene — run by a champion barista, pushing creativity for 8+ years.

venues.name: % Arabica Shanghai Roastery
venues.verdict: The Kyoto-born roaster's Shanghai flagship — sleek design and excellent coffee near the Bund.

venues.name: Café del Volcán
venues.hours: Mon–Fri 8 AM–8 PM, Sat–Sun 10 AM–8 PM
venues.verdict: A longtime favorite on Yongkang Road — consistently excellent espresso in the Former French Concession.

venues.name: Metal Hands Coffee
venues.verdict: Beijing's beloved roaster brought their A-game to Shanghai.

venues.name: Mellower Coffee
venues.verdict: Design-forward coffee brand known for beautiful spaces and creative signature drinks.

venues.name: Starbucks Reserve Roastery
venues.verdict: The world's largest Starbucks — 30,000 sq ft of coffee immersion.

venues.name: Akimbo Cafe Lab
venues.verdict: A true coffee laboratory — experimental drinks and meticulous technique.

venues.name: Rumors Coffee
venues.verdict: A Japanese-style kissaten tucked on a quiet, tree-lined street.

venues.name: Black Sheep Espresso
venues.verdict: A quirky, well-loved neighborhood specialty shop with a cute black sheep theme.

venues.name: Right Here Right Now (来喝来闹)
venues.verdict: A vibrant, trendy cafe that captures Shanghai's live-in-the-moment coffee energy.
